lines.c: 你好！想買啲咩？
lines.j: nei5 hou2! soeng2 maai5 di1 me1?
lines.e: Hello! What would you like to buy?

lines.c: 你好！我想買生果。
lines.j: nei5 hou2! ngo5 soeng2 maai5 saang1 gwo2.
lines.e: Hi! I'd like to buy some fruit.
optsJ: nei5 hou2! ngo5 soeng2 maai5 saang1 gwo2.

lines.c: 好呀，慢慢睇。呢啲生果好新鮮。
lines.j: hou2 aa3, maan6 maan6 tai2. ni1 di1 saang1 gwo2 hou2 san1 sin1.
lines.e: Sure, take your time. This fruit is very fresh.

lines.c: 幾錢呀？
lines.j: gei2 cin2 aa3?
lines.e: How much is it?

lines.c: 一個五蚊，十個四十蚊。
lines.j: jat1 go3 ng5 man1, sap6 go3 sei3 sap6 man1.
lines.e: Five dollars each, ten for forty dollars.

lines.c: 唔好意思,我唔係好明,可唔可以講慢啲？
lines.j: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 ming4, ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 maan6 di1?
lines.e: Sorry, I didn't quite understand — could you speak more slowly?
opts: 唔好意思,我唔係好明,可唔可以講慢啲？
optsJ: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 ming4, ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 maan6 di1?

lines.c: 當然！一個五蚊。你要幾多個？
lines.j: dong1 jin4! jat1 go3 ng5 man1. nei5 jiu3 gei2 do1 go3?
lines.e: Of course! Five dollars each. How many do you want?

lines.c: 我要三個。
lines.j: ngo5 jiu3 saam1 go3.
lines.e: I'll take three.

lines.c: 好,三個係十五蚊。
lines.j: hou2, saam1 go3 hai6 sap6 ng5 man1.
lines.e: Sure, three is fifteen dollars.

lines.c: 明白喇,多謝！
lines.j: ming4 baak6 laa3, do1 ze6!
lines.e: Got it, thank you!

lines.c: 喂！你食咗飯未呀？
lines.j: wai3! nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6 aa3?
lines.e: Hey! Have you eaten yet?

lines.c: 未呀，仲未食。點解問呢？
lines.j: mei6 aa3, zung6 mei6 sik6. dim2 gaai2 man6 ne1?
lines.e: Not yet, still haven't eaten. Why do you ask?

lines.c: 不如而家一齊去飲茶啦！你得唔得閒呀？
lines.j: bat1 jyu4 ji4 gaa1 jat1 cai4 heoi3 jam2 caa4 laa1! nei5 dak1 m4 dak1 haan4 aa3?
lines.e: Then let's go for yum cha now! Are you free?

lines.c: 而家唔得喎，我要返工。星期六呢？
lines.j: ji4 gaa1 m4 dak1 wo3, ngo5 jiu3 faan1 gung1. sing1 kei4 luk6 ne1?
lines.e: Now's no good — I have to work. What about Saturday?

lines.c: 星期六得呀！你去過嗰間茶樓未呀？
lines.j: sing1 kei4 luk6 dak1 aa3! nei5 heoi3 gwo3 go2 gaan1 caa4 lau4 mei6 aa3?
lines.e: Saturday works! Have you been to that teahouse before?

lines.c: 未去過喎。我哋幾時見面？
lines.j: mei6 heoi3 gwo3 wo3. ngo5 dei6 gei2 si4 gin3 min6?
lines.e: I haven't. When shall we meet?

lines.c: 朝早十點得唔得呀？
lines.j: ziu1 zou2 sap6 dim2 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
lines.e: Is 10 in the morning okay?

lines.c: 好呀！邊個一齊去呀？
lines.j: hou2 aa3! bin1 go3 jat1 cai4 heoi3 aa3?
lines.e: Great! Who else is coming?

lines.c: 得我哋兩個咋，我已經諗好喇。
lines.j: dak1 ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 zaa3, ngo5 ji5 ging1 nam2 hou2 laa3.
lines.e: Just the two of us — I've already decided.

lines.c: 明白喇！星期六朝早見啦！
lines.j: ming4 baak6 laa3! sing1 kei4 luk6 ziu1 zou2 gin3 laa1!
lines.e: Got it! See you Saturday morning!

lines.c: 你好！呢個係餐牌，想落單未呀？
lines.j: nei5 hou2! ni1 go3 hai6 caan1 paai4, soeng2 lok6 daan1 mei6 aa3?
lines.e: Hello! Here's the menu — ready to order?

lines.c: 我好餓，想要啲點心。
lines.j: ngo5 hou2 ngo6, soeng2 jiu3 di1 dim2 sam1.
lines.e: I'm very hungry — I'd like some dim sum.

lines.c: 飲咩呀？凍茶定熱茶？
lines.j: jam2 me1 aa3? dung3 caa4 ding6 jit6 caa4?
lines.e: What to drink? Cold tea or hot tea?

lines.c: 熱茶啦，唔該。有冇魚同蔬菜？
lines.j: jit6 caa4 laa1, m4 goi1. jau5 mou5 jyu2 tung4 so1 coi3?
lines.e: Hot tea please. Do you have fish and vegetables?

lines.c: 有呀，我哋啲魚係蒸嘅，好新鮮。
lines.j: jau5 aa3, ngo5 dei6 di1 jyu2 hai6 zing1 ge3, hou2 san1 sin1.
lines.e: Yes — our fish is steamed, very fresh.

lines.c: 好呀，要一條蒸魚同啲蔬菜。
lines.j: hou2 aa3, jiu3 jat1 tiu4 zing1 jyu2 tung4 di1 so1 coi3.
lines.e: Great, I'll have a steamed fish and some vegetables.

lines.c: 食得飽未呀？
lines.j: sik6 dak1 baau2 mei6 aa3?
lines.e: Are you full?

lines.c: 好飽喇，好好食！唔該埋單。
lines.j: hou2 baau2 laa3, hou2 hou2 sik6! m4 goi1 maai4 daan1.
lines.e: Very full — delicious! Bill please.

lines.c: 一共二百蚊，要唔要收據呀？
lines.j: jat1 gung6 ji6 baak3 man1, jiu3 m4 jiu3 sau1 geoi3 aa3?
lines.e: Two hundred dollars in total — would you like a receipt?

lines.c: 要呀，多謝！下次我去超市買食材，自己煮畀你食。
lines.j: jiu3 aa3, do1 ze6! haa6 ci3 ngo5 heoi3 ciu1 si5 maai5 sik6 coi4, zi6 gei2 zyu2 bei2 nei5 sik6.
lines.e: Yes please, thanks! Next time I'll go to the supermarket, buy ingredients, and cook for you myself.

lines.c: 今日天氣真係好好！
lines.j: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2!
lines.e: The weather is really lovely today!

lines.c: 係呀，太陽好猛，又唔熱。
lines.j: hai6 aa3, taai3 joeng4 hou2 maang5, jau6 m4 jit6.
lines.e: Yes — the sun is strong, but it's not hot.

lines.c: 嗰隻狗好可愛呀！係你養㗎？
lines.j: go2 zek3 gau2 hou2 ho2 oi3 aa3! hai6 nei5 joeng5 gaa3?
lines.e: That dog is so cute! Is it yours?

lines.c: 係呀，佢係我嘅寵物。我仲養咗一隻貓。
lines.j: hai6 aa3, keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 cung2 mat6. ngo5 zung6 joeng5 zo2 jat1 zek3 maau1.
lines.e: Yes, he's my pet. I also have a cat.

lines.c: 你隻貓係咩色㗎？
lines.j: nei5 zek3 maau1 hai6 me1 sik1 gaa3?
lines.e: What colour is your cat?

lines.c: 白色同黑色嘅。佢隻眼係藍色，好靚。
lines.j: baak6 sik1 tung4 hak1 sik1 ge3. keoi5 zek3 ngaan5 hai6 laam4 sik1, hou2 leng3.
lines.e: Black and white. Its eyes are blue — very pretty.

lines.c: 哇，聽日好似會落雨喎。
lines.j: waa3, ting1 jat6 hou2 ci5 wui5 lok6 jyu5 wo3.
lines.e: Wow. Looks like it'll rain tomorrow, though.

lines.c: 係呀，仲話有颱風。
lines.j: hai6 aa3, zung6 waa6 jau5 toi4 fung1.
lines.e: Yes, they say there's a typhoon coming too.

lines.c: 咁今日真係要好好享受啲太陽喇。
lines.j: gam2 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 jiu3 hou2 hou2 hoeng2 sau6 di1 taai3 joeng4 laa3.
lines.e: Then we really should enjoy the sun today.

lines.c: 啱呀！我哋帶隻狗去行下啦。
lines.j: ngaam1 aa3! ngo5 dei6 daai3 zek3 gau2 heoi3 haang4 haa5 laa1.
lines.e: Right! Let's take the dog for a walk.

lines.c: 你今日好似唔開心喎，做咩呀？
lines.j: nei5 gam1 jat6 hou2 ci5 m4 hoi1 sam1 wo3, zou6 me1 aa3?
lines.e: You seem unhappy today — what's wrong?

lines.c: 我有啲擔心，我媽媽病咗。
lines.j: ngo5 jau5 di1 daam1 sam1, ngo5 maa4 maa1 beng6 zo2.
lines.e: I'm a bit worried — my mum is sick.

lines.c: 吓？佢邊度唔舒服呀？
lines.j: haa2? keoi5 bin1 dou6 m4 syu1 fuk6 aa3?
lines.e: Oh? Where doesn't she feel well?

lines.c: 佢個頭好痛，仲有啲肚痛。
lines.j: keoi5 go3 tau4 hou2 tung3, zung6 jau5 di1 tou5 tung3.
lines.e: Her head really hurts, and her stomach aches a bit too.

lines.c: 唉，咁你一定好擔心。你爸爸知唔知呀？
lines.j: aai1, gam2 nei5 jat1 ding6 hou2 daam1 sam1. nei5 baa4 baa1 zi1 m4 zi1 aa3?
lines.e: Aw, you must be so worried. Does your dad know?

lines.c: 知呀，佢同我姐姐而家照顧緊佢。
lines.j: zi1 aa3, keoi5 tung4 ngo5 ze4 ze1 ji4 gaa1 ziu3 gu3 gan2 keoi5.
lines.e: Yes — he and my older sister are looking after her now.

lines.c: 你唔好太緊張，佢會好返嘅。
lines.j: nei5 m4 hou2 taai3 gan2 zoeng1, keoi5 wui5 hou2 faan1 ge3.
lines.e: Don't be too anxious — she'll get better.

lines.c: 多謝你。有你呢個朋友真係好。
lines.j: do1 ze6 nei5. jau5 nei5 ni1 go3 pang4 jau5 zan1 hai6 hou2.
lines.e: Thank you. I'm lucky to have a friend like you.

lines.c: 應該嘅！得閒一齊去探佢啦。
lines.j: jing1 goi1 ge3! dak1 haan4 jat1 cai4 heoi3 taam3 keoi5 laa1.
lines.e: Of course! When we're free let's visit her together.

lines.c: 好呀，佢一定會好開心。
lines.j: hou2 aa3, keoi5 jat1 ding6 wui5 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
lines.e: Yes — she'll be really happy.

lines.c: 唔該，請問去呢間酒店點行呀？
lines.j: m4 goi1, cing2 man6 heoi3 ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 dim2 haang4 aa3?
lines.e: Excuse me, how do I get to this hotel?

lines.c: 好近啫。你直行，然後喺前面轉左。
lines.j: hou2 kan5 ze1. nei5 zik6 haang4, jin4 hau6 hai2 cin4 min6 zyun3 zo2.
lines.e: It's very close. Go straight, then turn left up ahead.

lines.c: 行路遠唔遠呀？定係搭的士好啲？
lines.j: haang4 lou6 jyun5 m4 jyun5 aa3? ding6 hai6 daap3 dik1 si2 hou2 di1?
lines.e: Is it far to walk? Or is a taxi better?

lines.c: 唔使啦，行路五分鐘咋。喺後面仲有個地鐵站。
lines.j: m4 sai2 laa1, haang4 lou6 ng5 fan1 zung1 zaa3. hai2 hau6 min6 zung6 jau5 go3 dei6 tit3 zaam6.
lines.e: No need — it's just a five-minute walk. There's also an MTR station behind you.

lines.c: 明白！酒店附近有冇景點呀？
lines.j: ming4 baak6! zau2 dim3 fu6 gan6 jau5 mou5 ging2 dim2 aa3?
lines.e: Got it! Are there any attractions near the hotel?

lines.c: 有呀，對面有個好出名嘅景點，可以拍照。
lines.j: jau5 aa3, deoi3 min6 jau5 go3 hou2 ceot1 meng2 ge3 ging2 dim2, ho2 ji5 paak3 ziu3.
lines.e: Yes — opposite there's a famous attraction where you can take photos.

lines.c: 好正！要唔要買門票呀？
lines.j: hou2 zeng3! jiu3 m4 jiu3 maai5 mun4 piu3 aa3?
lines.e: Awesome! Do I need to buy a ticket?

lines.c: 要呀，不過而家要排隊，好多人。
lines.j: jiu3 aa3, bat1 gwo3 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 paai4 deoi2, hou2 do1 jan4.
lines.e: Yes, but right now you'd have to queue — lots of people.

lines.c: 咁我聽日先去啦。多謝晒你！
lines.j: gam2 ngo5 ting1 jat6 sin1 heoi3 laa1. do1 ze6 saai3 nei5!
lines.e: Then I'll go tomorrow instead. Thank you so much!

lines.c: 唔使客氣！祝你旅途愉快！
lines.j: m4 sai2 haak3 hei3! zuk1 nei5 leoi5 tou4 jyu4 faai3!
lines.e: You're welcome! Enjoy your trip!

lines.c: 喂，今日開唔開會呀？
lines.j: wai3, gam1 jat6 hoi1 m4 hoi1 wui2 aa3?
lines.e: Hey, is there a meeting today?

lines.c: 開呀，不過我部電腦壞咗。
lines.j: hoi1 aa3, bat1 gwo3 ngo5 bou6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2.
lines.e: Yes, but my computer is broken.

lines.c: 吓？係咪上唔到網呀？
lines.j: haa2? hai6 mai6 soeng5 m4 dou3 mong5 aa3?
lines.e: Oh? Can't get online?

lines.c: 係呀，個訊號好差，WiFi又壞咗。
lines.j: hai6 aa3, go3 seon3 hou6 hou2 caa1, WiFi jau6 waai6 zo2.
lines.e: Yeah, the signal's bad and the WiFi's down too.

lines.c: 你打電話問下老闆啦。
lines.j: nei5 daa2 din6 waa2 man6 haa5 lou5 baan2 laa1.
lines.e: Call and ask the boss.

lines.c: 好啦。講起，今個月出咗糧未呀？
lines.j: hou2 laa1. gong2 hei2, gam1 go3 jyut6 ceot1 zo2 loeng4 mei6 aa3?
lines.e: Okay. By the way, has this month's pay come through yet?

lines.c: 出咗喇，今朝啱啱入咗銀行戶口。
lines.j: ceot1 zo2 laa3, gam1 ziu1 ngaam1 ngaam1 jap6 zo2 ngan4 hong4 wu6 hau2.
lines.e: It has — it just went into the bank account this morning.

lines.c: 好彩！我等錢交租。
lines.j: hou2 coi2! ngo5 dang2 cin2 gaau1 zou1.
lines.e: Lucky! I need the money for rent.

lines.c: 你而家返屋企定係放工先去銀行？
lines.j: nei5 ji4 gaa1 faan1 uk1 kei2 ding6 hai6 fong3 gung1 sin1 heoi3 ngan4 hong4?
lines.e: Are you going home now or to the bank after work?

lines.c: 放工先去啦，而家仲要開會添。
lines.j: fong3 gung1 sin1 heoi3 laa1, ji4 gaa1 zung6 jiu3 hoi1 wui2 tim1.
lines.e: After work — I still have the meeting now.

lines.c: 聽日得閒，不如去行山啦！
lines.j: ting1 jat6 dak1 haan4, bat1 jyu4 heoi3 haang4 saan1 laa1!
lines.e: If you're free tomorrow, let's go hiking!

lines.c: 好呀！我最鍾意行山，又可以做運動。
lines.j: hou2 aa3! ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 haang4 saan1, jau6 ho2 ji5 zou6 wan6 dung6.
lines.e: Yes! I love hiking — it's good exercise too.

lines.c: 啱呀！行完我哋仲可以去游水。
lines.j: ngaam1 aa3! haang4 jyun4 ngo5 dei6 zung6 ho2 ji5 heoi3 jau4 seoi2.
lines.e: Right! After, we can go swimming too.

lines.c: 哎呀！我跌親，隻腳好痛！
lines.j: aai1 jaa3! ngo5 dit3 can1, zek3 goek3 hou2 tung3!
lines.e: Ow! I fell — my foot really hurts!

lines.c: 吓？你受咗傷呀？仲行唔行得呀？
lines.j: haa2? nei5 sau6 zo2 soeng1 aa3? zung6 haang4 m4 haang4 dak1 aa3?
lines.e: What? Are you injured? Can you still walk?

lines.c: 行唔到呀，好似好嚴重。
lines.j: haang4 m4 dou3 aa3, hou2 ci5 hou2 jim4 zung6.
lines.e: I can't — it seems quite serious.

lines.c: 唔好郁住！我即刻打999叫救護車。
lines.j: m4 hou2 juk1 zyu6! ngo5 zik1 hak1 daa2 gau2 gau2 gau2 giu3 gau3 wu6 ce1.
lines.e: Don't move! I'll call 999 for an ambulance right now.

lines.c: 唔該晒你！好彩有你喺度。
lines.j: m4 goi1 saai3 nei5! hou2 coi2 jau5 nei5 hai2 dou6.
lines.e: Thank you so much! Lucky you're here.

lines.c: 唔使驚，救護車好快到。
lines.j: m4 sai2 geng1, gau3 wu6 ce1 hou2 faai3 dou3.
lines.e: Don't be scared — the ambulance will be here soon.

lines.c: 知喇，多謝你！下次小心啲先得。
lines.j: zi1 laa3, do1 ze6 nei5! haa6 ci3 siu2 sam1 di1 sin1 dak1.
lines.e: Okay, thank you! Next time we'd better be more careful.
